source_row.extraction_instructions: eusem.org is Joomla/K2 with no structured events list: /events is a news feed and the RSEvents calendar is empty. The listing override reads the home-page menu links to /education/courses-traineeships/<slug>, loads each article and keeps those stating an upcoming date (Date(s) label, else first non-deadline line with a full date). Detail is prose: fee rows under a bare 'Fee' heading, venue under a 'Venue' label. The Congress (eusemcongress.org) is a separate site and the 2026 edition is over.

concerns: Only 3 upcoming events exist on the site today; the volume is small and each page is free prose, so a re-worded page can drop an event (undated or deadline-first pages are skipped, never guessed). Not covered: Basic Emergency Care Course 2026 (250 EUR) states no date; eCourses / refresher / EM Monthly have no dates; the EUSEM Congress site has no 2027 edition yet.

Coverage: fees checked on page; EMPOWER (fully booked) states no fee, its two 'here' links are a brochure flip-book (no fee text) and a waiting-list form, so [] is justified; Crash Course says 'TBC'. No image fee tables, no registration sub-page, no call for papers on any of the 3. Harness COVERAGE flags PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK on EMPOWER only, for the reason above.
Venue is parsed from a 'Venue - ...' line or a 'Venue' label in the extractor (the base class does not); city prefers the intro sentence over the page's own typo ('Bilboa').

Shared-file note: llm_agent._merge_shell_and_detail reads is_sold_out from the shell only, so a detail-level is_sold_out (set by wordpress_generic.detail_from_html) is dropped for every family subclass. I set it on the shell in the listing override for EUSEM, SAM and Derma. Base class should do the same.
